name: REDLINER [⚡UZI]
desc:
Roblox Plus players earn +50% Yen.

A fast-paced FPS game that combines swordplay, gunplay, and parrying, with an in-depth movement system.
There is no speed limit.

Controls
[LMB] - Melee
[Q] - Gun
[F] - Parry (You can parry bullets)
[RMB] - Grapple
[SHIFT] - Dash
[CTRL] - Slide
[SPACE] - Wallrun (Against a wall)
All keybinds are changeable.

Credits : qitadel (main dev), reverity (skins), anti- (skins) dere1235 (art), lunaticyz (ffa map), asciimynetzach (2v2 map)

Music Credits: asc, SKYLINE, Inverted Variable, beansclub, Exodia, Sadance, Zhnoi, doc, s4turnine, parallel21, seawansia, violetsky
